1cbaa7e41ee4566a29fe179cb881e453490e661f.summary: OFAC sanctioned Yin Kecheng, a Shanghai-based hacker the Treasury says is affiliated with China's Ministry of State Security, and Sichuan Juxinhe Network Technology, believed involved with Salt Typhoon. Yin was associated with a late-2024 compromise of Treasury's Departmental Offices network, attributed to Silk Typhoon (Hafnium), which exploited a zero-day in BeyondTrust. OFAC earlier sanctioned Integrity Tech over Flax Typhoon activity. A $10,000,000 reward is offered for information on hackers targeting US government or critical infrastructure.

1cc02a914495f8aabbbaa07d4de1b065b311bee8.summary: Kaspersky GReAT's quarterly APT summary for Q3 2023. It covers a long-running secure USB campaign against APAC government entities, and BlindEagle's rotation through open-source RATs against South American targets. It also covers BadRory, an unattributed group targeting Russia, and the GOFFEE campaign against Russia. Other items: TargetPlug, the Middle East activity (StrongyPity, Operation BlackCrescent, Lyceum), BellaCiao linked to Charming Kitten, MuddyWater's customised Ligolo tunnelling tool, Lazarus targeting defence firms, Origami Elephant's Firebird backdoor, and ScarCruft's…

hedges: The report says it believes the USB attacks were carried out by a highly skilled threat actor interested in espionage.
The report assesses with low confidence that the Operation BlackCrescent activity has ties to the Lyceum group.
The report says it is currently unable to link the BadRory activity to any known group.
The report says Lyceum is believed to be Farsi-speaking, and that language artefacts do not necessarily indicate geographic relation.
The report says it could not tie most BlackCrescent victims to specific industries or to a specific threat actor.
The report notes its summaries reflect its own visibility, and other sophisticated attacks may have gone undetected.
The report's language labels (Russian-speaking, Chinese-speaking and so on) refer to language artefacts in malware, not necessarily to geography.
